day.author: Andreas Mischok
day.note: Clear sky, strong sun, lush trees and a pond with Chinese garden buildings. High contrast.

dusk.author: Greg Zaal
dusk.note: Sun on the horizon over water, warm orange glow, old buildings on both sides of a stone waterfront.

night.author: Greg Zaal
night.note: City at night, lit buildings and neon skyline across a river, dark sky, warm lamps on a paved promenade.
